geeklist.title: Moving Auction
geeklist.description:
Moving in a month and going to try to clean up some excess before doing so.
- Shipping from 01906 will be in addition to the bid price. I will use whatever provider you want, or the cheapest available under pirateship.
- All items will be listed in US Dollars. Please bid in whole dollars.
- This auction will end January 18th at 6:00PM Eastern Time.
- I'll accept payment via Paypal, Venmo, or Cash on site.
- All games come from a smoke free home and are well taken care of. The condition is listed for all games. Several items have specific benefits or shortcomings so please make sure to read the listing.
- All sales will go through BGG so they get their 3%.
- There is a concurrent auction going on for PROMOS (listed by my fiance). We separated it out so as to not clutter the list. Anyone that wins things in both auctions will obviously be combined for shipping. https://boardgamegeek.com/geeklist/370812/promo-auction-us-only-ends-11826-5pm-est
- If you have any questions or concerns, please post or Geekmail me.
